ld.name: NOW Foods, Methyl B-12, 1,000 mcg, 100 Lozenges
ld.description: Nervous System Health Essential for Energy Production Methylcobalamin A Dietary Supplement Vegetarian/Vegan Kosher Vitamins Family Owned Since 1968 Quality GMP Assured Halal Vitamin B-12 is necessary for the production of energy from fats and proteins and is well known for its critical role in DNA synthesis, as well as in homocysteine metabolism. Methylcobalamin is the co-enzyme form of vitamin B-12 that has been found to be especially critical in the maintenance of a healthy nervous system. Dietary sources are almost exclusively of animal origin (meat and dairy) and supplementation with B-12 may be especially important for strict vegetarians. NOW® Methyl B-12 is vegetarian/vegan (non-animal derived).

blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: Vitamin B-12 is necessary for the production of energy from fats and proteins and is well known for its critical role in DNA synthesis, as well as in homocysteine metabolism. Methylcobalamin is the co-enzyme form of vitamin B-12 that has been found to be especially critical in the maintenance of a healthy nervous system. Dietary sources are almost exclusively of animal origin (meat and dairy) and supplementation with B-12 may be especially important for strict vegetarians. NOW® Methyl B-12 is vegetarian/vegan (non-animal derived).

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Take 1 lozenge 1 to 2 times daily. Chew lozenge or hold in mouth until dissolved and swallow.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Xylitol, hydroxypropyl cellulose, microcrystalline cellulose, citric acid, stearic acid (vegetable source), natural flavors, organic stevia leaf extract (enzyme-modified steviol glycosides) and organic monk fruit extract.
Made and quality tested in the USA with globally sourced ingredients.
Not manufactured with wheat, gluten, soy, milk, egg, fish, shellfish, tree nut or sesame ingredients.
Produced in a GMP facility that processes other ingredients containing these allergens.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Natural color variation may occur in this product.
For adults only. Consult physician if pregnant/nursing, taking medication, or have a medical condition. Keep out of reach of children.
Contains Xylitol, which is harmful to pets.
Store in a cool, dry place after opening.
